name: lagune
description: 🌊 Your security copilot as you build, your Blue Team when you audit, whether you're a developer or not.

interface.shortDescription: Detect, plan, harden, and verify the security of any project
interface.longDescription: Lagune runs a Blue Team workflow on your project: it sets security principles, detects what the project does, plans the fixes that matter for it, applies them, and proves each one holds.
